title: Reader TTS settings sheet exposes developer-facing mixed English copy
symptom: The reader TTS settings tab displayed supporting copy such as "直接展示系统 TTS engine 当前可用的 voice。", exposing implementation terminology inside the user-facing settings UI.
root_cause: ReaderTtsSettingsSheet hard-coded technical supporting text directly in the Composable instead of keeping the sheet copy user-facing and domain-appropriate.
fix: Replaced the voice, speech-rate, pitch, and timer supporting text with concise user-facing Chinese copy.
Added an instrumented Compose test that renders the TTS tab and asserts developer terms such as "TTS engine", "voice", "短句块", "机械感", and "新会话" are not present in visible text.
failed_attempts: Existing settings-sheet tests only covered tab forwarding, theme color leakage, fallback voice status, and missing orphan labels; they did not assert the quality of visible supporting copy.
impact: Improves visual polish and prevents implementation terminology from leaking into reader settings, especially in the TTS tab where users expect clear controls rather than technical descriptions.
